sloka: चतुर्दशसहस्राणि रक्षसां त्वत्पिता च यः।त्रिशिरा दूषणश्चैव दण्डके निहता मया ।। ६.७९.१९ ।।
transliteration: caturdaśasahasrāṇi rakṣasāṁ tvatpitā ca yaḥ।triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva daṇḍake nihatā mayā ।। 6.79.19 ।।

translations.english: "In Dandaka, fourteen thousand Rakshasas, your father, Trisira, and also Dooshana were killed by me alone."
